title: "Save to File" .glb meshes revert material on scene after ".godot" folder deletion
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3, 4.4

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 5 1600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

I have a .glb file containing a mesh and a material assigned to it (or any amount of those). I used "save to file" on that file, to get a mesh in a .res file.
Then I put that mesh on a scene, and I try to assign to it a custom material - this works, even after reopening the project.
But if I then delete the ".godot" folder, next time opening the project the mesh will have the original material assigned, not the one I assigned before.
So if I try to open the project for example on different machine that does not have a .godot folder yet generated, it will lose all the custom materials I assigned to meshes on the scene.
**This makes the project behavior dependent on the specific generation of .godot directory**

### Steps to reproduce

Using the MRP project:
1. Open it. On the scene "main" you should find a MeshInstance with an **orange** material
2. Select it, and change the field under Mesh > Surface 0 > Material to use blue_material.tres

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5165d4a-3e3e-4602-85d5-4cd6fb8aad3a)

4. The cube should be **blue**
5. Save the project, close it and reopen it.
6. The cube should still be **blue**. This **works**
7. Now close the project, **delete the .godot directory**, and reopen the project
8. The cube should be **orange**, not blue. This does **not work**

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[import-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20233122/import-test.zip)
